summary.title: Let's Build Instagram with Ruby on Rails - Free Edition
summary.one_liner: You learn to build an Instagram-style photo sharing app (Photogram) in Rails by working through CRUD for posts, image uploads with Paperclip, and forms with simple_form.
takeaways: Generate a posts controller, RESTful resources routes, and a root route pointing at posts#index
Create a Post model with a caption string and attach images using the Paperclip gem
Validate image presence and content type, and resize images with a styles option
Build new/create forms for posts using simple_form and an image file field
The guide encourages renaming everything and struggling through tasks rather than copying code
summary.summary: This is the free edition of a Next Step Ruby on Rails guide that builds an Instagram-like app called Photogram. The excerpt covers chapter one, which walks through Create, Read, Update, Delete for posts: generating a posts controller, adding resources routes and a root route, creating a Post model with a caption, and adding image uploads via the Paperclip gem with validations. The author deliberately leaves many steps as exercises with hidden hints, and the text notes that HAML or ERB views are optional. The page is a Dropbox-shared PDF and the excerpt ends partway through setting up the new post form.
